assertions.reason: The 32-bit block interleaver at 10 kHz exceeds the 2.1 ms added-buffering allowance; measured host p99.9 is 4.248 ms.

missing_metric_reasons.ber: No comparable RF bits observed, or this probe does not expose bit decisions.
missing_metric_reasons.reacquisition_time_s: No post-dropout valid header observed, or no dropout in this case.
missing_metric_reasons.stac_adjusted_goodput: Audit attachment requires login; adjustment and standby definitions unverified.
missing_metric_reasons.stac_usable_time_fraction: No production standby-time instrumentation; local proxy is separately labeled.

observations.delivery_silence_definition: Time between correct application deliveries, including startup and the right-censored terminal interval. No invented outage threshold; audio sample-clock resolution.
observations.latency_clock: deterministic audio sample clock; CPU, OS, device latency unmeasured

modem_delay_estimates.scope: Analytical residence estimates, not CPU times: serialization includes coding and mean pilot duty; Viterbi emits bytes after its lookahead. Startup, byte/symbol alignment and actual pilot positions remain in the measured one-sample reference. These estimates are not subtracted from the latency assertion.

observations.source_to_framer_scope: Message creation to first-byte framer consumption; sample-clock observations have audio-block resolution; host observer timestamps are exact steady-clock call times.

parameters.agc_envelope: linear dB attack to requested step; 50 ms hold; linear dB decay to baseline
parameters.audio_filter: 129-tap Hamming-window FIR + two first-order edge allpasses
parameters.audio_jitter_model: Seeded block delay begins at audio_event_s; monotonic arrivals; production deadline check rejects arrivals beyond declared playout slack
parameters.crypto: AES-128-CTR, fixed test key/counter, no AEAD
parameters.doppler_definition: 2*sigma of Gaussian power spectrum; zero path carrier shifts

equalizer.pilot_gain_trigger: power excursion; recursive tracking remains active until gain returns within 5% of baseline
equalizer.recursive_phase_scope: feedforward signal only; feedback decisions remain in the corrected constellation
equalizer.support_candidate_estimator: shadow NLMS on inactive coefficients; active RLS coefficients retained

parameters.gaussian_fading_filter: 129 taps at 32*spread Hz; stationary initialized history; linear audio interpolation
parameters.impulse_arrivals: periodic at declared rate; Gaussian burst RMS relative to Gaussian floor
parameters.papr_scope: finite clean pulse-shaped RF waveform, including acquisition, training, headers, pilots and tails; no PA model or power increase assumed
parameters.rf_payload_budget: requested audio seconds times complete-waveform payload duty; finite payload completed including partial-segment startup/tail
parameters.scheduler_policy: One replaceable bid until framer claim; newer same-key market update supersedes regardless of bid; highest bid per wire byte, newest on ties; no age boost
parameters.seed_policy: mt19937 Box-Muller; independent XOR-derived stage seeds; counter-based payload
parameters.snr_definition: nominal unit-mean-constellation complex-sample signal/noise power before fading; not 3 kHz SNR or Eb/N0

soft_metric_parameters.decoder_output: Viterbi hard decisions checked by existing message CRC

parameters.source_event_clock: Integral sample periods derived from event index; variable overload periods accumulated; source tick misses checked for aligned B5 events
parameters.source_revision_note: git_commit is the base revision; source_tree_sha256 identifies the tested working-tree snapshot
parameters.waveform: Goblin Cannon single_carrier; not a certified Appendix D waveform

metric_definitions.added_software_latency_ms: per-message source-to-sink latency minus a paired one-sample-block production-stack reference; retains signed differences; reference includes serialization, modem/FEC and epoch startup
metric_definitions.ber: erroneous bits / compared received RF bits; lost bits excluded and observation fraction reported
metric_definitions.coded_ber: post-payload-FEC bit errors / compared decoded source bits; missing data is not zero BER
metric_definitions.delivery_silence_ms: correct-delivery intervals, including startup and right-censored ending, at audio sample-clock resolution; no outage threshold assumed
metric_definitions.frame_error_rate: (missing + corrupted RF symbol frames) / transmitted frames
metric_definitions.frame_survival_fraction: complete, bit-exact RF symbol frames / transmitted frames
metric_definitions.goodput_bps: delivered useful message bits/s for message probes; error-free raw RF frame bits/s for RF probes (not application goodput)
metric_definitions.latency_ms: creation at source to delivery at sink on the simulated sample clock, including startup and audio block residence; excludes unmeasured CPU/OS/device time
metric_definitions.latency_percentiles: nearest-rank p50, p99, p99.9 and max; null if no deliveries
metric_definitions.message_delivery_fraction_of_framed: correct messages delivered / messages claimed by the production framer, including startup and terminal censoring; excludes source auction rejections
metric_definitions.reacquisition_time_s: first validated header after dropout end minus dropout end; null when no recovery observed
metric_definitions.rf_recovery_ms: declared RF lock loss to next validated header, excluding planned marker transitions; incomplete outage reported separately
metric_definitions.uptime_fraction: receiver-locked simulated sample time / complete observation time, including startup
metric_definitions.usable_time_fraction: local proxy: fraction of one-second windows containing at least one correct delivered message; not the STAC audited definition

latency_stage_breakdown_ms.method: Matched message identities, one-sample reference. Host per-call CPU and queue observations are in the sidecar; call-duration percentiles are not added together.

modem_residence_estimates.scope: Analytical residence estimates, not CPU times: serialization includes coding and mean pilot duty; Viterbi emits bytes after its lookahead. Startup, byte/symbol alignment and actual pilot positions remain in the measured one-sample reference. These estimates are not subtracted from the latency assertion.

notes: Quiet-host paced loopback; interleaver buffering is charged against 2.1 ms by disabling it in the paired intrinsic reference.
FSK uses a longer declared duration to observe deliveries across complete headers and payload frames; no duration reduction for runtime.

observations.added_buffering_scope: Interleaving and diversity combining wait are disabled only in the intrinsic reference, so their waiting time is included in the 2.1 ms assertion. Coding and RF serialization remain enabled.
